jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Cloud & HPC Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define and manage integrated project plans including scope, deliverables, budget, and resource allocation.
• Lead high-impact projects involving cloud services, high-performance computing (HPC) platforms, and secure compute environments.
• Act as the primary coordinator for research stakeholders, architects, security teams, and external partners.
• Manage infrastructure modernization, system integrations, and large-scale migration initiatives.
• Establish agreements regarding service ownership, support responsibilities, and operational models.
• Identify and mitigate delivery risks while ensuring adherence to quality and acceptance criteria.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience managing complex Cloud, Infrastructure, Datacenter, or HPC projects.
• You possess a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
• You're able to translate between research needs and technical, security, and operational requirements.
• You bring advanced skills in project planning, organization, and outcome-oriented risk management.
• You possess the technical understanding of secure environments necessary to challenge plans and coordinate specialists.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• 8+ years of experience with Cloud adoption, platform modernization, or compute-intensive environments.
• Previous experience working in highly secure infrastructure environments.

Responsibilities

• Design, configure, and optimize the Elastic Security platform to collect and correlate security event data.
• Integrate log data from a predefined list of systems and applications into the ELK stack.
• Develop and maintain security-focused dashboards and reports using Kibana to meet organizational needs.
• Execute platform upgrades and ensure the scalability and reliability of the SIEM infrastructure.
• Integrate threat intelligence feeds into Elasticsearch for proactive hunting and incident detection.
• Monitor security logs and alerts across cloud and on-premise environments to identify anomalies.
• Document technical procedures, system diagrams, and delivery artifacts to support security operations.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in security engineering with a focus on SIEM and the Elastic Stack (Kibana, Logstash, Kafka).
• You possess 3+ years of experience managing both Linux and Windows operating systems.
• You bring expertise in Elasticsearch, including data indexing, querying, and visualization techniques.
• You have experience integrating security logs within cloud environments such as AWS and Azure.
• You possess knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, API scripting, or ES/QL.
• You have experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), network security, and intrusion detection tools.
• You bring familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as SOC2 or ISO 27001.
• You have experience working with cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes.
• You're proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in incident response scenarios.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with the Elastic APM (Application Performance Monitoring) module.
• Knowledge of Elastic Agent and various beats collectors.
• Active knowledge of English.

A healthy work-life balance in a company that put employees first and stands for their wellbeing

We are looking for a System & Network Engineerto strengthen the internal IT team of a structured company. Here, you'll find an environment where technology matters, people come first, and professional growth doesn't have to come at the expense of your personal life.
System & Network Engineer - Your Role

System & Network Engineer - Your Profile

You will be working as a Data Analytics Intern in the Business Intelligence department at Bosch Home Comfort in Mechelen. Your main responsibility will be to further develop and maintain the 360-degree view of our customers, which will be used to steer the departments (Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, etc). You will support in projects and process optimization. You will maintain and harmonize the data present in different applications. Furthermore, you will be responsible for several Sales reports (in Power BI and Excel) and may be asked to conduct several analyses. Additional from these tasks also customer creation in SAP and CRM will be other important tasks to follow up.  

You are currently a student (Data Analytics, Statistics, International Business Management, Marketing, Economical Studies, etc.) and you are interested in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence. You have excellent analytical and problem solving skills. You are curious and have a positive mindset. You are well-organized, can work independently, efficiently and are self-motivated. Good communication skill and solution oriented mindset is must.

You have practical knowledge of MS Excel and Power BI. Fluency in English is mandatory. Good knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

We are looking forward to receiving your application by e-mail in English (please mention the exact title of the position). Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further questions.

You will work in the Department Corporate Communications and Governmental Affairs Benelux with involvement in various tasks and projects.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

Jobomschrijving

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.Customer Service Excellence

• Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
• Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
• Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
• Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
• Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.
Compliance & Documentation

• Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
• Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
• Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
• Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
• Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
• Professional level in Dutch, French and English

• Our client is a leading international player in the energy distribution sector.

Jobomschrijving

• Primarily focused on indirect procurement, with strong exposure to operational and industrial activities.
• Responsible for Transportation & Logistics categories, representing the largest spend area within the portfolio.
• Oversees procurement of Maintenance, Engineering Services, and MRO to support operational continuity.
• Manages suppliers across technical, industrial, and logistics sectors.
• Collaborates with Category Managers on strategic and global sourcing categories.
• Manages an annual spend of approximately €50M.
• Manage and develop strategic supplier relationships, ensuring optimal performance, compliance, and long-term value creation.
• Lead end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing, tendering, contract negotiation, and supplier selection.
• Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities while maintaining service excellence and operational continuity.
• Collaborate closely with operations, logistics, finance, legal, compliance, and other key stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs.
• Monitor procurement KPIs, provide performance reporting, and contribute to continuous improvement and best-practice initiatives.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
• 4  years if experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supplier management within an international, industrial, logistics, or energy-related environment.
• Strong negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills.
• Ability to influence stakeholders and operate effectively within a matrix organization.
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Property Management Assistant - FT or 4/5 - Zaventem
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

Jobomschrijving

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file management or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Jobomschrijving

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

jobs.occupation: Receptionist - International Law Firm - Centre Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international law firm. With a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative, multicultural environment, fostering a supportive and people-oriented workplace. There are located next to a metro and bus station and at walking distance from a train station.

Jobomschrijving

As a Receptionist you'll be responsible for:

• Manage the reception area and ensure a professional and welcoming experience for visitors.
• Answer and direct incoming phone calls.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, including scheduling, room setup, and catering arrangements.
• Oversee office supplies and maintain stock levels.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, and deliveries.
• Provide administrative support for document management, invoicing, and office-related processes.
• Support the wider office team with ad hoc administrative tasks and projects.

• First professional experience in reception, hospitality, customer service or administration is a plus.
• Excellent communication skills with a strong service-oriented mindset.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.
• Ability to multitask and remain organised in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word and Excel).
• Excellent spoken and written English and French; Dutch is a plus.

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:

• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)
• Receiving and processing customs documents
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?

• Minimum A2 diploma 
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator
• Able to work independently and manage priorities
